{{Spell InfoBox|image=Hover.png|type=Spell Boost|rarity=Normal|misc_a_1=Hover in place for 2 seconds at the completion of the spell|misc_a_2=Hover in place for 3 seconds at the completion of the spell|misc_a_3=Hover in place for 5 seconds at the completion of the spell}}'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Rarity|Normal]] [[Spells|Spell]] of [[Spell Types|Type]]: Spell Boost. The affected spell is cast normally but when the spell ends, it's projectile(s) hover in place for a short time.

== Interactions ==

* [[Arcane Explosion]]: No further damage beyond the casting of the spell.
* [[Thunderstorm]]: Lightning strikes continue until spell disappears.
